statement: MediaTek's Q2 2026 revenue was NT$152.18 billion ($4.68 billion), up 1.2% year over year, while operating income fell 22% year over year to NT$22.87 billion ($705 million) as it funds an AI datacenter push with a $5 billion board-approved financing.
why: Flat revenue with a sharp margin drop shows the challenger is spending ahead of accelerator revenue, which bears on how durably it can fund the capacity build.

impact.mechanism: Heavy investment ahead of revenue compresses current profitability while building future non-GPU accelerator supply, so the alternative-supply expansion depends on continued financing.

evidence.excerpt: revenue NT$152.18 billion ($4.68 billion), up 1.2% year over year. Operating income NT$22.87 billion ($705 million), down 22% year over year.

confidence.basis: Reported results relayed by a single secondary outlet rather than the company filing.
